theorems.statement: One closed symmetric periodic set of arbitrarily near-full measure omits infinitely many terms from every nonzero affine copy of every non-eventually-zero exponentially decaying real sequence with an eventual balanced polynomial recurrence.

theorems.statement: The same common set works for all stable real constant-coefficient recurrence sequences, with nonreal or repeated roots and exact zeros permitted.
Finite rational hitting certificates are found by a terminating exhaustive search over compact outer approximants; the assembled closed set has computable measure.
The abstract rational-family theorem permits log Delta_N=o(N) in place of polynomial degree growth.
I(t)=t 2^(t/3) h(t) for every t>0; h(z)=2^(-z/3)I(z)/z is holomorphic for Re z>0.

theorems.statement: For theta_n=b^(-1/2)exp(gamma/(2n)), the residue has expansions to every order in n^(-1), uniformly for bounded real gamma.
An arbitrary-order lattice local expansion holds with a uniform absolute error over the full offset lattice.
